Jules (partnerships): Heads-up — ACME Reseller says their PO for Atlas GPU batch hasn't routed into our ledger. PO 987654321 is showing as UNROUTED in their portal. Can we triage? @Priya @Evan :rotating_light:
ACME Reseller (external): Confirmed, we submitted through the marketplace portal at 09:12 PT. The vendor portal returned an accept but no PO ack to our ERP. Support ticket 5542 opened.
Priya (legal): I can check contract entity mappings, but need the marketplace invoice payload. Can someone paste the raw acknowledgement? :eyes:
ACME Reseller (external): Pasting the portal ack snippet:
```
{"po":"987654321","status":"accepted","seller_entity":"AcmeTech LTD","buyer_entity":"Redwood Inference Inc","ack_id":"ack_5542"}
```
Maria (ops): Thanks. On our side billing-bot shows a routing error for that ack: ERR_ROUTE_422 - billing entity mismatch. Looks like seller_entity casing/alias didn't match ledger record.
Evan (finance): If ledger expected "AcmeTech, Inc." vs "AcmeTech LTD" that would prevent auto-mapping. We have a manual alias table but this reseller isn't aliased yet. If legal confirms entity that's blocking approval and invoice settlement.
Priya (legal): I can sign off on an alias if ACME provides a DUNS or tax ID. ACME, can you share the tax_id used on the PO?
ACME Reseller (external): Tax ID is 12-3456789, DUNS 987654321. We can send a signed certificate now.
Jules (partnerships): OK — plan: 1) Evan to add alias in finance mapping (manual) 2) Maria to re-run routing job for ack_5542 3) Priya to accept alias after docs. Target: clear routing within 2 business hours. @billing-bot kick reroute when done.
Evan (finance): Adding alias now: mapping entry AcmeTech LTD -> AcmeTech, Inc. (internal id: vend_3009). Will post once propagated.
billing-bot: reroute job queued for ack_5542 (job_id: reroute_202403).
Maria (ops): Re-run complete. Route status: ROUTED -> queued for invoice generation.
Priya (legal): Received tax docs, alias approved.
Evan (finance): Verified in ledger — invoice gen started, PO 987654321 moved to INVOICED.
ACME Reseller (external): Confirmed we received invoice and payment terms. Thanks everyone. :tada:
Jules (partnerships): Great — leaving this thread open for one hour for any regressions, then will close. Thanks all.
